correction_to_F14: F14 reported GPLL as no confirmed NetBSD counterpart after inspecting display/CDCLK/sideband files. The complete pinned GT RPS source proves GPLL calculation already existed there, inside caller-held IOSF CCK mutex. Therefore the F14 helper alone cannot safely replace that call; both VLV and CHV RPS init sites must move the helper invocation to BEFORE the combined IOSF lock to avoid nonrecursive nested lock.
